LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_AteLavishMeal: Delicious! Me eat until belly nearly burst! Human food tastes good! Kishishit!
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_AteFineMeal: Tasty meat food! Feels damn good! Chomp chomp!
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_AteRawFood: Me eat it raw! No fire needed. Blood taste, meat taste, best taste! Goblins like raw food!
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_AteKibble: Me ate beast food... Tastes like dog feed. At least belly full. Ugh...
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_AteCorpse: Me tore into corpse! Teeth hurt chewing bones, but blood dripped everywhere. Very good! Kishishit!
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_AteHumanlikeMeatDirec: Human meat fresh! Veins chewy and tasty! Is this what humans call raw beef? Me want more!
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_AteHumanlikeMeatAsIng: Cooked human meat! Humans really are tastiest thing in world! Me want it every day!
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_AteInsectMeatDirect: Bug meat chewy. Gray juice squirted out. A little fishy... Me want human meat.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_AteInsectMeatAsIngred: Bug meat warmed by fire. No gray juice! Boss is clever! Ooh!
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_AteRottenFood: Ugh... Me ate rotting meat. Sour and strange. Going to make bad poop... Hate it...
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_NeedRest: Kishishit... Boss... Eyes closing... Marching hard...
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_SleptOnGround: Me snored on dirt! Back hurts! Feels like playing with females too much.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_SleptInCold: Too cold! No fire? Goblin almost froze! Other goblins eat frozen goblin, so be careful!
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_SleptInHeat: Warm and damp, like being inside human female belly! Me miss female who birthed me... Ate her when hungry, so cannot see her now...
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_SleepDisturbed: Who stepped on me while me snoring? Me pull sausage out through their bellybutton!
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_AteWithoutTable: Table? What is table, human? Human trying to trick goblin again! Want fingers cut off again? Goblin not stupid!
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_EnvironmentDark: Very dark! Cannot see anything! Feels like being inside human female belly!
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_NeedBeautyUgly: Base dirty? Lots of trash? Bones rolling around? That makes it properly goblin! Feels secure!
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_NeedBeautyBeautiful: Looks grand! Like where humans live! No dung, no stink! This is a human house!
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_NeedRoomSizeCramped: Room small! But narrow dark burrow feels cozy.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_KnowColonistDied: Friend dead... Sad... But curious! What friend meat taste like? Bet it tasty!
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_ColonistBanished: Deh-heh-heh! That one only ate our food anyway! Get lost!
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_WitnessedDeathAlly: Goblin head came right off in front of me! Wow! So much blood! Kishishit! Weak runt!
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_WitnessedDeathNonAlly: Kishishit! That weakling died! Me saw it! Serves them right! Now me taste the meat!
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_ObservedLayingCorpse: Ooh! Uncut human corpse on ground! Meat lying around! Eat before it rots!
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_ObservedLayingRotting: Waste! Edible corpse rotted! White worms everywhere. Cannot eat it or decorate with it! Aaagh!
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_ButcheredHumanlikeCor: Me sliced human with knife! Stripped bones and pulled guts! Lots of tasty meat! Kishishit!
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_KnowButcheredHumanlik: Boss! We really eating human meat today? Me excited! Kishashashat!
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_PawnWithGoodOpinionDi: Goblin I played with is dead. Things might get a little boring, but that's fine! There are plenty more goblins!
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_PawnWithBadOpinionDie: Rotten one who always fought me is dead! Kahaha! Serves them right! My fists were stronger! Me win!
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_MyChildDied: My runt died... Ugh, fine! Weak runts not needed! Make more runts! Catch human female and make lots more! Kishishit!
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_MySpouseDied: My toy died! Little sad. Cannot make babies with it now... Ugh.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_MyFatherDied: Old goblin who looked like me went stiff! Kishishit! Weak thing was useless!
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_MyMotherDied: Human female who birthed me died! Always cried about going home. Now she is dinner!
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_MySiblingDied: Littermate died... We rolled in same pit... Little sad. But goblins make many more, so me not worry!
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_ApparelDamaged: Big holes in clothes! Air flows and it feels light! Goblins do not care about fashion!
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_DeadMansApparel: Stole dead one's clothes! Free loot! Blood and sweat smell, but free clothes best!
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_HumanLeatherApparel: Wearing human-skin clothes! Do me look human now?
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_GotSomeLovin: Me played with female! Body all loose and feels good! Want to make babies again!
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_RebuffedMyRomanceAtte: Me talked and got ignored! Think me ugly? Maybe smash head! Grrr!
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_WasEnslaved: They put dog collar on me! Goblin should fight and raid, not be slave! Me angry! Kill all and escape!
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinThought_ObservedTerror: Me saw black monster! Spooky... But if we put it in pot, does it make meat soup? Yum?
